disposition_reason: Table 1 prints arsenic, cadmium, mercury and lead (mean, SD, range, median, quartiles) for 41 retail honeys from Algeria and Poland, by country and by botanical type.

study.design: Retail survey with exposure and risk indices
study.market: retail outlets in different regions, original packaging
study.method: Closed-vessel microwave digestion (HNO3); Cd and Pb by ICP-MS (NexION 300D) standard mode, As in KED mode; Hg by AMA-254 amalgamation AAS
lod: LOD: As 0.019 µg/kg, Cd 0.017 µg/kg, Pb 0.16 µg/kg; Hg 0.003 ng/sample
study.qa: CRM INCT-MPH-2 (Polish herbs) before analysis and every 10 samples; recoveries As 104%, Cd 104%, Pb 97.5%, Hg 103.5%
